name: Cement asphalt mortar (CAM)
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 位于轨道板与下部基础之间的水泥沥青类砂浆材料。
usage_note: 文中以平面内连续分布的弹簧—阻尼元件近似其作用。
usage_overview: 作为轨道板与下部支承之间的材料层，提供连续弹性支承，并通过其刚度和阻尼参与振动传递。在相关车辆—轨道及桥梁耦合模型中，常以平面内连续分布的弹簧—阻尼元件近似其动力作用。

complete_examples.text: The matrices for slab track-girder interactions are marked with the subscripts “sb ” and “bs ”, which are derived by the interactions between the slab tracks and the girder connected by the cement asphalt mortar (CAM).

The matrices for girder-pier interactions are marked with the subscripts “bp ” and “pb ”, which are derived by the interactions between the girder and the pier connected by the cement asphalt mortar (CAM).
A cement asphalt mortar (CAM) layer is filled between the slab tracks and the subgrade, which is regarded as spring–dashpot elements continuously distributed in the X–Y plane.
